unreplied.preview: Illiani will prepare to magically fortify Axtra if they're going to try to reinforce the bridge.
Twilight spins in a circle with the branch turned sparkler, letting out occasional chirps of delight.

Axtra's work looks impeccable, the precision of the weaves she makes throughout the bridge is reminiscent of a spider's webbing. Each section of rope supports the next section of rope as they become intertwined.

"There! Probably some of my best work!"

Illiani still seems a bit concerned.

"Should we still go one at a time, just to be safe?"

Upon hearing the words, Axtra turns towards Illiani. Her lower lip begins to tremble slightly as a discernible frown replaces the proud smile she had moments ago. 

Her eyes grow glossy as they slowly well up with tears. "But... I did so good..."

Illi immediately backpedals and attempts to explain herself.

"OH! nonono, I mean, what if they have people watching the bridge, and have some other traps left to spring! You did a wonderful job!"

Between her sniffles and face wiping, Axtra manages to let out a few words.

"Okay... sniff That makes sniff sense..."
